# AI Symphony

> Built by Arto Oinonen

AI Symphony is an orchestrator for autonomous AI development teams. It uses CrewAI and LiteLLM to coordinate specialized agents (Product Manager, Developer, Reviewer) that collaborate to turn high-level ideas into production-ready Pull Requests or validated business reports.

## Architecture
- **Orchestration**: CrewAI (Sequential process)
- **Model Interface**: LiteLLM via OpenRouter (supports 100+ models including local LLMs)
- **Workspace**: Custom Git/File management via GitPython
- **Integrations**: PyGithub for PR management

## File Structure
- `src/main.py`: Entry point and crew kickoff logic.
- `src/tools/`: Custom Tool implementations (Workspace, GitHub).
- `src/config/`: Agent and task YAML configurations.
- `docs/`: Architecture documentation and decision records.
- `samples/`: Example outputs from different modes.

## Key Decisions
- **Unified LLM Access**: Using LiteLLM to allow seamless model swapping (cloud or local).
- **Tool-Oriented Development**: Agents are forced to use workspace tools for all file operations.
- **Ephemeral Workspaces**: All work happens in temporary, clean clones of the target repo.
- **Dual Modes**: Code mode for PRs, Business mode for idea validation reports.

## Installation
```bash
pip install git+https://github.com/traali/AI-Symphony.git
```

## 2026 Roadmap
- **MCP**: Standardize tool access via Model Context Protocol.
- **Sandboxing**: Secure execution in ephemeral microVM environments.
- **Feedback**: Implement recursive test-fix loops for autonomous reliability.
